snippet.title: RaidCast — Your Chat. Your Army. | Now on Unity
snippet.description:
Your chat. Your army.

RaidCast is a free PC strategy game made by a streamer, for streamers. Viewers type !join on Twitch, Kick or YouTube, and their heroes and troops march into the streamer's battle. Between streams, everyone grows their own city, hero and army.

Play free on PC: https://playraidcast.com/

Art and code made with AI tools; design, balance and testing by the developer, who plays it live every day.
